## Known issue

**npm audit reports GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf (picomatch ReDoS, `<= 4.0.7`), which has no patched release yet.** In the published package it is reached only through `vite`, which the Inspector uses for `--web --dev`, and the globs it matches come from developer configuration rather than from MCP servers or the network. Every other package `npm audit` flags is flagged only through picomatch. We will take a fixed picomatch as soon as one is published ([#3000](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/issues/3000)).

## What's Changed

### v1.x security fixes

1.0.6 is a security release for the deprecated v1 line. Upgrade with `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@v1-latest`, or move to v2 (`@latest`).

* **A malicious MCP server can no longer crash the proxy by streaming an unbounded server-sent event.** The proxy now caps how much of an upstream SSE stream it will buffer. A single line, or a single event, longer than 16 MiB closes that upstream connection with an error instead of growing the proxy's heap until it runs out of memory and drops every session. This covers the `sse` and `streamable-http` transports, including a standalone GET stream with the wrong content-type. The cap sits well above any legitimate message (four times the SDK reference servers' 4 MB inbound limit). ([GHSA-3xgv-mvj6-g78r](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-3xgv-mvj6-g78r)) by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2998
* **A v1 release no longer moves the GHCR image's `latest` tag.** `ghcr.io/modelcontextprotocol/inspector:latest` stays on the current v2 image. by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/2959
* chore(release): bump version to 1.0.6 by @cliffhall in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/pull/3005

## What's Changed

### Security fixes

 2.15.0 fixes four vulnerabilities. The fetch-guard and event-stream fixes affect every v2 release from 2.0.0 through 2.14.0, the mcpdo daemon fix affects 2.10.0 through 2.14.0, and the server.json preview fix affects 2.14.0. Upgrade with `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@latest`.

* **The fetch guard blocks cloud metadata addresses outside `169.254.0.0/16`**, including `100.100.100.200` and `192.0.0.192` and their decimal and IPv4-mapped IPv6 forms, so neither the `/api/fetch` proxy nor OAuth discovery can be pointed at them ([GHSA-fvg8-f358-w2c8](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-fvg8-f358-w2c8))
* **The network tracker caps the body it records for a POST event-stream response**, so a server streaming an unbounded response can no longer exhaust the web backend's memory and take down every session ([GHSA-9w48-x22j-rrm7](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-9w48-x22j-rrm7))
* **The server.json launch preview shows every environment variable's value**, flags runtime-control variables such as `NODE_OPTIONS` and `npm_config_registry` with a warning, and requires confirmation before the server can be added ([GHSA-pp85-586h-2m95](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-pp85-586h-2m95))
* **`mcpdo` verifies the connection daemon before sending it anything**: the daemon must prove it holds this user's token, so an impostor listening on the daemon's socket or pipe receives no credentials ([GHSA-5572-x678-xmv8](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-5572-x678-xmv8))

## What's Changed

### v1.x security fixes

1.0.5 is a security release for the deprecated v1 line. Upgrade with `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@v1-latest`, or move to v2 (`@latest`).

* **The proxy now refuses two more fixed cloud metadata addresses.** Its connection guard already blocked `169.254.0.0/16`. It now also blocks `100.100.100.200` (Alibaba Cloud ECS) and `192.0.0.192` (Oracle Cloud Classic), including their IPv4-mapped IPv6 forms. ## What's Changed

### Security fixes

2.14.0 fixes three vulnerabilities reported privately against v2. Upgrade with `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@latest`. One of them, GHSA-2fw8-7jmw-r937, also affects the deprecated v1 line, where it is fixed in 1.0.4 (`@v1-latest`).

* **An MCP App can no longer navigate its sandbox frame away from the policy it was given.** The proxy enforces a frame policy built from the app's approved CSP grants. When the frame starts to leave the document the host loaded, it closes the relay and removes the frame, and it tells the host why. ([GHSA-h9j8-vj8g-v3gg](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-h9j8-vj8g-v3gg))
* **server.json import shows the exact command before it is saved**, and rejects a package with an invalid or empty environment-variable name or unsafe tokens. **URL elicitations open only http(s) URLs.** Any other scheme is refused, with a reason. **The HTML preview's CSP now precedes all document markup.** ([GHSA-rwv7-mh2c-ff2p](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-rwv7-mh2c-ff2p))
* **Server-supplied schema patterns are checked in bounded time.** Tool output and app elicitation schemas use a linear-time matcher with per-pattern and per-schema limits. A pattern beyond those limits is reported as unverified instead of being evaluated. ([GHSA-2fw8-7jmw-r937](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-2fw8-7jmw-r937))

### Upgrading

* **The Node floor is now `^22.23.4 || ^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1`**, the October 2026 Node security releases (#2822). npm prints `EBADENGINE` on older versions. The field is advisory, so the Inspector still runs.
* **`--load` latency now counts successful calls only.** `latencyMs` and the `--load-max-p99` gate cover successful calls only, failed calls are reported separately as `errorLatencyMs`, and tool-error text is now shown (#2836). If no call succeeds, `--load-max-p99` fails with a message saying there is no p99 to check.

## What's Changed

### v1.x security fixes

1.0.4 is a security release for the deprecated v1 line. Upgrade with `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@v1-latest`, or move to v2 (`@latest`).

* **Server-supplied `pattern` regexes are no longer evaluated.** Patterns in a tool's output schema and in an elicitation's requested schema are stripped before validation, including patterns reachable through `$ref`, and the elicitation form no longer passes them to the browser's own field validation. The result says which checks were skipped. A schema the Inspector cannot transform safely, such as one that declares `$id` or anchors, is reported as not validated instead of being evaluated. Because patterns are no longer evaluated, a value that fails a server's `pattern` is now accepted, with that note. Every other schema constraint still applies. ([GHSA-2fw8-7jmw-r937](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/inspector/security/advisories/GHSA-2fw8-7jmw-r937))
